data.name: Hadi
data.gender_notes: Hadi is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Hādī means 'guide'. Its root is ه-د-ي (h-d-y). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Hādī). Hadi is a Arabic name meaning “Guide; leader”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hadi expresses “Guide; leader”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Hādī means 'guide'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadi total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
